name: Roasted Makhana
steps: Choose a broad pan so the makhana can move freely as you stir. Heat the ghee over medium-low heat, then add makhana and toss to coat lightly.
Roast for 8–10 minutes, stirring and turning frequently so pieces crisp evenly without darkening too fast. Reduce the heat if brown spots appear before the centres are crisp.
Remove one piece, let it cool enough to handle and break it open. It should snap crisply rather than feel chewy; if chewy, continue roasting and check again.
Turn off the heat, sprinkle over cumin powder, pepper and salt, and toss while the makhana is still warm so the seasoning sticks without burning.
Serve warm, or spread out to cool completely before transferring to an airtight container. Sealing while warm traps steam and softens the crunch.
tips: Test a piece: it should break crisply rather than feel chewy.
substitutions: Any substitution changes the recipe: recheck allergies, Jain rules and quantities.
notes: Prices are sample ingredient-cost assumptions. Replace with supplier rates before procurement.
